published.note: Published 2026-11-27 from the run's own files. Local paths are anonymised as <evidence> and <corpus>; answer texts, request rows and call ids are removed (see 'removed'). The harness (tools/fast-track-map) is on an unreleased branch, so this records what ran, not a reproduction script in this release.

original_files.role: the task set, for the gold answers

removed: every answer text and every request row (each server's task answers are reduced to right or wrong per item, in the task set's order, as the 'marks' string; texts are compared only for the identical-item counts)
the containers' log lines, except those naming the KV cache size, FP8, Marlin or a KV cache scaling factor
per-server CPU thread readings and the rows of every cell

the name of the third-party checkpoint's publisher: its Hugging Face repository id, its served model name, its label and its setup id (published as l4-8b-fp8-ckpt-fp8-kv). The revision and the weight files' hashes are kept
the task-set throughput of each server: this run measured answers only, and its rules do not read speed

versions.what: the rules, written 2026-11-26 09:04 CET and committed 09:06 CET, before any server
addendum written 10:17 CET before the relaunch of servers 2 and 3: keep batch 1, rerun servers 2 and 3
10:22 CET, after the relaunch started: the relaunch's spend cap and its budget flag only
addendum written 13:11 CET before the second relaunch of the three servers still missing

rules.note: The decision rule (quality.py's paired comparison, three servers per setup, the 3-point margin) did not change between versions.

instructions.gsm8k: Solve this problem. Show your working, then give the final answer on the last line in the form "Answer: <number>".
instructions.mmlu: Answer this multiple-choice question. Explain your reasoning briefly, then give the final answer on the last line in the form "Answer: <letter>".

task_set.grading: quality.py at the rules commit: the number after the last 'Answer:' line (GSM8K) or the letter A to D standing alone after it (MMLU); a failed request is wrong

l4-8b-defaults.label: vLLM 0.34.0 defaults (the current setup)
l4-8b-defaults.added_because: the model's own context (40,960 tokens) needs more KV cache than one L4 holds next to BF16 weights, and vLLM refuses to start then; the longest request of the plan is under 5,000 tokens

l4-8b-fp8-ckpt-fp8-kv.label: A third-party published FP8 checkpoint of Qwen3-8B that also quantizes the KV cache
l4-8b-fp8-ckpt-fp8-kv.added_because: the model's own context (40,960 tokens) needs more KV cache than one L4 holds next to BF16 weights, and vLLM refuses to start then; the longest request of the plan is under 5,000 tokens

l4-8b-fp8-ckpt-qwen.label: Qwen's published FP8 checkpoint
l4-8b-fp8-ckpt-qwen.added_because: the model's own context (40,960 tokens) needs more KV cache than one L4 holds next to BF16 weights, and vLLM refuses to start then; the longest request of the plan is under 5,000 tokens
